sql: SELECT TOP 10 gc.CardNumber AS voucherNumber, gc.Name AS name, gc.Amount AS amount, gc.RemainingAmount AS remainingAmount, gc.StartDate AS startDate, gc.ExpirationDate AS expirationDate FROM dbo.ZnodeGiftCard gc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = gc.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND gc.IsActive = @isActive AND gc.RestrictToCustomerAccount = @restrictedToCustomer AND gc.StartDate <= @now AND gc.ExpirationDate >= @now AND gc.RemainingAmount > @zeroAmount AND (@owner IS NULL OR gc.UserId = @owner) AND (@notOwner IS NULL OR gc.UserId <> @notOwner) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR gc.CardNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY gc.GiftCardId
